title: fix(rest)!: the /meta item and list reads serve a view stored with no label without an invented label
body:
Fixes #23967

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

`GET /api/v1/meta/view/NAME` and `GET /api/v1/meta/view` served a view stored with no `label` as if it had one: `label` equal to its qualified name (`OBJECT.KEY`). This happened on the standalone server and on the runtime dispatcher. The spec declares a view's `label` optional with no default (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`). The value came from the read-side translator: `translateView` answers `view.label ?? view.name` when the catalog carries no string for the view. The view-container read already dropped that fallback (#22614); the item and list reads did not.

The rule is now one module-private helper in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `withoutInventedViewLabel(input, translated)`. All three `view` sites call it:

- `translateMetaDocument`'s single-view arm: the item read. `translateMetaEnvelope` wraps it, and `RestServer.translateMetaItem` delegates to it.
- `translateMetaList`'s per-element map: the list read. `RestServer.translateMetaItems` delegates to it, and the runtime dispatcher's `/meta` domain imports it.
- `projectViewTranslation`: container slots and the container's own strings. Its inline check is replaced by the helper, with the same semantics. The reverse run below shows the container answer is unchanged.

The rule: a `label` equal to the view's `name`, where the stored view carried none, is not served. An authored label is served as authored, including one equal to the name. A catalog translation is still served, for a view with a label and for one without. A catalog string equal to the qualified name cannot be told apart from the fallback, so it is dropped with it, as it already was on the container path. No export is added. `packages/spec`, `rest-server.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` are not touched.

The console half is a separate card that the seat files on objectstack-ai/objectui when this lands: `viewTabLabel` (`view.label || view.name || view.id`) needs its own human fallback. It is not addressed here, and the console tab keeps showing a machine name for such a view until then.

## Evidence

### Live boot, BASE `adce19297` vs HEAD (standalone `os dev`)

From a scratch directory outside the repo: `examples/app-todo` compiled with `os compile -o SCRATCH/objectstack.json`, booted with `os dev --artifact ./objectstack.json --fresh -p PORT` and placeholder admin credentials. Recipe: `POST /packages` (201), `PUT /meta/object/recheck_gate?package=com.qa.recheck` with label, plural label and `sharingModel` (200), `PUT /meta/view/recheck_gate.default` with no `label` (200), `PUT /meta/view/recheck_gate.named` with `label: "All gates"` (200).

| read (no Accept-Language, `en`, and `zh-CN`: the same in all three) | BASE | HEAD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /meta/view/recheck_gate.default` | 200, `label: "recheck_gate.default"` | 200, no `label` key |
| `GET /meta/view`, element `recheck_gate.default` | 200, `label: "recheck_gate.default"` | 200, no `label` key |
| `GET /meta/view`, elements whose `label` equals `name` | `[recheck_gate.default]` | `[]` |
| `GET /meta/view/recheck_gate.named` and its list element | 200, `"All gates"` | 200, `"All gates"` |
| `GET /meta/view/recheck_gate.default/layers`, overlay and effective | no `label` | no `label` |

### Cloud host shape, BASE vs HEAD

`new HttpDispatcher(kernel)`, which is what `createHonoApp` builds, loaded from the built `@objectstack/runtime` dist. That dist imports the built `@objectstack/rest`. The protocol double serves three stored views: label-less `default`, authored `named`, and label-less `tagged`, which the `zh-CN` catalog translates.

| case | BASE | HEAD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default locale resolves, no Accept-Language: `default` / `tagged`, item and list | `label` = own name | no `label` key |
| `zh-CN`: `default`, item and list | `label: "recheck_gate.default"` | no `label` key |
| `zh-CN`: `tagged` / `named` | `已标记` / `全部闸门` | `已标记` / `全部闸门` |
| no default locale, or no i18n service, no Accept-Language | no `label` key (nothing is translated) | no `label` key |

The last row is the PM's mechanism assumption 2: with no resolvable locale, no other layer adds the label.

### Pins: `packages/rest/src/meta-view-label-not-invented.test.ts`, 39 rows

- §1 runs through the standalone routes `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` and `GET /api/v1/meta/:type`, over a real `SchemaRegistry` and the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, with the views seeded as stored rows. It has one row per locale and view: label-less (no key), authored, catalog-translated label-less, and authored equal to name. It also covers the card's read with no Accept-Language and no catalog.
- §2 runs through `translateMetaEnvelope` and `translateMetaList`, the functions the dispatcher's `/meta` domain imports, with the same rows, a bare array and the `{ type, items }` envelope. It also covers no catalog, no mutation, and no locale (the same document is returned).
- §3 is a CONTROL: the container read answers what it answered before.

### Reverse verification and ablation (one-shot, nothing left in the tree)

The subject is reached by relative import (`./meta-item-read-gate.js`, and `./rest-server.js` imports it relatively), so it resolves to `src/`; no rebuild sits between legs. Each leg below was proven on disk. The reverse leg's blob equals the BASE blob. Each ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob changed. Each restore was proven: blob equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| leg | result |
| --- | --- |
| CONTROL, HEAD unmutated | 39 / 39 green |
| REVERSE, the whole file at BASE | 15 red, exactly the label-less rows on both reads. All authored and translated rows and both §3 container rows stay green, so the container answer is unchanged. |
| item site ablated (`return translated`) | 9 red, the item-side label-less rows only |
| list site ablated (`return out`) | 9 red, the list-side label-less rows only |
| container site ablated (helper bypassed in `projectViewTranslation`) | the 2 §3 rows red |

## Surface note

The claim's file surface was the source file, one test file and one changeset. A fourth file is needed: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains one row (`packages/rest/src/meta-view-label-not-invented.test.ts`, `findOne`, pinned 1). `check:engine-double-contract` requires it for the new pin's fake engine and prescribes `--write`. The regeneration printed 0 rows lost; no other row moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other translatable types (PM assumption 5).** The `object`, `app`, `dashboard`, `dataset`, `page` and `picklist` translators serve `label` only from the catalog or the document; none falls back to `name`. `action` does: `resolveActionLabel` answers `action.name` and `translateAction` always writes `label`. But `ActionSchema` declares `label` required (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:959`), so a schema-valid stored action always carries one. No reach was measured, so this is not filed.
- **The fallback's source (PM assumption 6).** `resolveViewLabel`'s `view.label ?? view.name` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:481`) is unchanged.
  - In this repo, `translateView` is called by this module's three sites and by the public-form route in `rest-server.ts`. That route takes only the translated `config` and keeps its own label reading.
  - `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` names both functions in docblocks only, with no import.
  - objectui main (`63d00da`) calls neither.
  - After this PR, no served door carries the fallback. The exported function's answer is `domain:spec` ground; it is noted and not filed.
- **Consumers (PM assumption 4).**
  - The published response types are `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.item: z.unknown()` and `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema.items: z.array(z.unknown())`.
  - No `packages/client` type requires a served view's `label`, and no test asserts that a served view's `label` equals its name.
  - The CLI's `serve-view-container-read` integration test asserts authored labels.
  - The dogfood `view-container-cross-package-default` test compares the item and list reads, which now take the same rule.
- The card's object recipe now needs `sharingModel`. Without it the PUT answers 422 `security-owd-unset`, an authoring rule that postdates the card's run.
- Booting a compiled artifact from a directory with no `node_modules` logged `runtime module load FAILED ... Cannot find package '@objectstack/spec'`, and the todo app's hook was refused at boot. This was seen only in this scratch setup, and it does not touch `/meta`. Whether an artifact is meant to boot without its dependencies is not established here; noted, not filed.
